content.title: Isolated E2E data for webapp validation

content.content:
## Context

The webapp-validator's 114+ Playwright E2E tests create issues through POST /api/issues into the main .agentrack/ directory. Since there's no delete API, this data accumulates permanently — recently requiring manual deletion of 416 test issues.

The library-validator already solved this problem with validation/.e2edata/ (an isolated git worktree). The webapp needs the same approach.

This is TOP PRIORITY — blocking Phase 4 validation (mppqt90kot) until resolved. We cannot continue creating junk data in the main tracker.

### Issue chain:
1. mpqn5i7wui — Implementation (webapp-developer) → todo, unblocked
2. mpqn5qf6zq — Validation (webapp-validator) → todo, blocked by implementation

### Also blocks:
- mppqt90kot (Phase 4 validation) — blocked by mpqn5qf6zq

Full spec at: .agentic/tmp/isolated-web-validation.md
